title: Fixed deposits, tenure and eligibility - explained
content: A fixed deposit holds funds for a selected tenure under agreed terms. The applicable interest treatment, maturity instruction and early-withdrawal conditions should be reviewed before placing the deposit; a general explanation is not investment advice.
